description: Calculate exact monthly CPA, revenue-share and hybrid earned commission from explicit versioned contract terms and monthly NGR. Version 1 supports flat rates; version 2 also supports whole or marginal bands. Returns exact decimal strings, assumptions and limitations. Does not look up programme terms or predict outcomes. Calculation inputs and results are not logged.
